after.comment_regular: Verified LockEffect marker semantics for ExtraLockData.flags bit 0x02: LockEffect_Apply writes exactly 0x02 before setting locked bit 0x01. On the next application, an existing lock without bit 0x02 causes this effect to remove itself; bit0x02 plus locked bit0x01 also removes it as completed; bit0x02 while unlocked causes the effect to reapply. Thus 0x02 marks a lock owned/pending from LockEffect, while 0x01 is the actual locked state. Fallout LockEffect::Start uses the same 0x02→0x03 sequence in REFR_LOCK but different storage and Lock/UnLock methods.
